text: Like Cinderella waiting for her fairy godmother... You're stuck in a dead-end job. Do you:

options.text: A) Hope a magical promotion falls into your lap while you keep sweeping floors?
B) Complain to friends and wait for someone to notice your potential?
C) Network quietly and apply for better gigs on the side?
D) Quit dramatically, start your own hustle, and end up sleeping under a bridge to build your empire?

text: Channeling Aurora's eternal nap... Your dream vacation gets canceled last-minute. Your reaction:

options.text: A) Curl up in bed, scroll TikTok, and let fate reschedule it someday?
B) Vent online and hope friends rally with alternatives?
C) Pivot to a solo road trip you've always secretly wanted?
D) Sue the airline, book a better adventure, and end up maxing out your credit cards to turn it into a viral story?

text: Twisted like Rapunzel in her tower... You're in a toxic relationship. Deep down, you:

options.text: A) Stay put, dreaming of a prince to climb up and save you?
B) Hint at your unhappiness, waiting for them to change?
C) Set boundaries and seek therapy to untangle yourself?
D) Cut the metaphorical hair, walk out, and build a fortress of self-love?

text: Insane like Pocahontas facing the unknown... Aliens invade Earth (hypothetically). You:

options.text: A) Hide in the woods, hoping world leaders handle it?
B) Join a support group for doomsday preppers?
C) Learn alien tech from scraps and form a resistance?
D) Negotiate peace single-handedly, and end up beaming up to their mothership alone?

text: Painful like Mulan's hidden identity... A family secret blows up at reunion dinner. Do you:

options.text: A) Smile through it, pretending everything's fine forever?
B) Whisper to a sibling for backup before addressing it?
C) Confront it head-on with facts and feelings?
D) Rewrite the family narrative, disown the drama, and end up alienated but starting fresh?

text: Like Belle buried in books... Your best friend borrows your favorite novel and ruins it. You:

options.text: A) Forgive instantly with a hug, because kindness wins?
B) Politely ask for a replacement while hiding your annoyance?
C) Call them out with a witty roast, but offer to shop for a new one together?
D) Unleash a dramatic monologue about boundaries, then ghost them?

text: Funny like Jasmine's tiger tantrums... You're at a party, and someone spills wine on your outfit. Your vibe:

options.text: A) Laugh it off sweetly, offering them a napkin?
B) Smile through gritted teeth, changing topics gracefully?
C) Joke about it being "fashionable tie-dye" while demanding dry cleaning cash?
D) Roar like Rajah, douse them back, and declare party dominance?

text: Deep like Elsa's ice isolation... You're overwhelmed by emotions after a breakup. How do you express it?

options.text: A) Bottle it up sweetly, baking cookies for everyone instead?
B) Cry quietly to a close friend, seeking comfort?
C) Journal fiercely, then share empowering posts online?
D) Build an emotional fortress, freeze out the ex, and conquer new horizons?

text: Insane like Merida's arrow antics... In a zombie apocalypse (because why not?), your survival style:

options.text: A) Hide sweetly in a bunker, sharing rations with survivors?
B) Form alliances gently, but whisper warnings about threats?
C) Lead raids with clever traps and sassy one-liners?
D) Go full feral, archery-zombie heads while yelling battle cries?

text: Painful like Moana's ocean call... You discover a betrayal by a mentor figure. Your confrontation:

options.text: A) Swallow the hurt sweetly, preserving the peace?
B) Express disappointment softly, hoping for reconciliation?
C) Demand answers with firm boundaries and walk if needed?
D) Call them out epically, sever ties, and end up sailing into your own legend—bridge or no bridge?
